title: IrreversAct-Bench: A Dataset of Actions Labeled by Reversibility, Scope, and Blast Radius

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A labeled reversibility dataset unblocks multiple safety research threads. Clear infrastructure contribution with a well-defined causal chain to downstream safety improvements.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Annotation work is structured and accessible. Students can annotate actions from existing traces. The main complexity is obtaining high-quality agent traces and developing consistent annotation guidelines. No heavy compute needed.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 500 agent actions with three annotation dimensions each is a large annotation effort. Creating annotation guidelines, obtaining traces, and ensuring inter-annotator reliability takes substantial time. Could be scoped down to 100-150 actions.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
